29 유럽 Electric mobility in China: New country dossier from NOW GmbH
Electric mobility in China: New country dossier from NOW GmbH
2026-08-12
Berlin, August 2026.China is continuing to expand its role as the world’s leading market for electric mobility. With around 44 million electric passenger cars in use and more than 20 million charging points, China now has the world’s largest fleet of electric vehicles and the most extensive charging network. At the same time, the country is increasingly developing into a global centre of innovation and production for batteries and electric vehicles. These are the findings of the updated China country dossier from NOW GmbH’s ‘Electric Mobility International’ series.
The country dossier analyses the development of battery-electric mobility and hydrogen mobility in China, describes the policy framework and support mechanisms, and assesses current market trends.
Alongside the successes, the dossier also highlights current challenges. After years of strong growth, the first signs of market consolidation are emerging in the Chinese automotive industry. This is occurring at the same time as Chinese manufacturers’ export activities are expanding.
This publication is aimed at policymakers, public administration, academia, the business community and all stakeholders who follow international developments in the field of electric mobility and hydrogen technologies.
The country dossier “Electric Mobility International: China” is now available to download in German language free of charge:Elektromobilität international: China (PDF)

31 유럽 European Union CO2 standards for cars and vans: Low-carbon steel credits
European Union CO2 standards for cars and vans: Low-carbon steel credits
2026-08-06
August 6, 2026 |By:  Marta Negri and Georg Bieker
The European Commission’s proposed amendments to the carbon dioxide (CO2) standards for passenger cars and vans would allow manufacturers to use low-carbon steel credits to permit residual tailpipe CO2emissions of new vehicles after 2035. Because the emissions of steel production are already covered in the policy framework of the Emissions Trading System (ETS), however, the additional tailpipe emissions are not expected to be compensated by additional emission reductions in steel production.
Despite this, if the low-carbon steel credit mechanism is designed to support fossil-free steel investments in the EU, the credits can provide demand certainty for fossil-free production capacity and support the steel sector in meeting its long-term decarbonization requirements under the ETS.
This policy brief finds that there is enough announced capacity in the EU to limit steel credits to fossil-free steel.By contrast, including coal-based steelmaking and not limiting the eligibility of recycled steel would create windfall credits and displacement effects and risk delaying the transition to fossil-free steel. Additionally, a fair translation of steel-related emissions into the CO2standards requires calibrating the Commission’s proposed formula to define the baseline emissions intensity with EU-specific values, only accounting for the steel quantity that ends up in finished vehicles, and applying a real-world correction factor.

New course: Bidirectional charging in the LadeLernTOOL
2026-07-30
The free e-learning course is particularly geared towards municipal decision-makers as well as planning experts. Energy providers, municipal utilities, grid operators and companies with charging infrastructure or electric fleets will also benefit.
The 30-minute course provides information on the technical fundamentals as well as the relevant economic, regulatory and practical issues. Participants learn how electric vehicles can be used in future as flexible energy storage systems and what role they can play in a stable and sustainable energy system.
Johannes Pallasch, Director and Spokesperson of the National Centre for Charging Infrastructure:“Bidirectional charging offers great potential to make electric mobility even more attractive to consumers. Our course provides the necessary foundational knowledge and demonstrates what is already possible today. At the same time, we are at the early stages of development and we must better understand how people will use the various applications in their daily lives in future.”
In a series of three thematic modules, the course addresses key aspects of bidirectional charging: It explains the differences between controlled charging and bidirectional applications such as Vehicle-to-Home, Vehicle-to-Building, and Vehicle-to-Grid. In addition, technical and organisational prerequisites are outlined – from vehicles and wall boxes to communication standards and smart metering systems. Another focus issue is current market development, specific application examples as well as a realistic evaluation of opportunities and existing challenges. The compact course is designed to take around 30 minutes, in addition to around five minutes for a final test.
Interactive elements such as hotspots, flip cards and practical exercises support the learning process and enable a direct knowledge transfer. At the same time, the course addresses widespread myths surrounding bidirectional charging and sets the record straight. These include the concern that bidirectional charging heavily strains the vehicle battery or that range is lost when electricity is fed back into the grid. In this way, participants receive a well-founded and objective overview of the current status of the technology. Following successful completion,  participants receive a certificate confirming their knowledge about bidirectional charging.
Following a short registration process, the LadeLernTOOL is available for use free of charge. Alongside the StandortTOOL, the FlächenTOOL and the MasterplanTOOL, the LadeLernTOOL belongs to the four central instruments of the TOOLBox that provides custom and data-based support to municipalities expanding their local charging infrastructure. All TOOLs are made available by the National Centre for Charging Infrastructure under the NOW GmbH umbrella.
On behalf of the Federal Ministry of Transport, the National Centre for Charging Infrastructure coordinates and manages activities for the expansion of charging infrastructure in Germany. It supports the planning, implementation and funding of charging infrastructure. In order to better understand the demand for charging stations, it collects relevant data. It connects all major stakeholders and shares its expertise. Their focus is always on the consumer.
Further information can be found here:www.nationale-leitstelle.de
 NOW GmbH Press Releases

메르세데스-벤츠 밴은 9월 14일부터 20일까지 독일 하노버에서 열리는 IAA Transportation 2026의 13번 홀에 독자 부스를 마련하며, 밴 부문 130주년을 기념한다. 토마스 클라인 메르세데스-벤츠 밴 대표는 9월 14일 오전 9시(중앙유럽 서머타임) 기자회견을 열어 전략과 향후 개발 계획, 최신 혁신 기술을 공개할 예정이다. 회사는 1896년 칼 벤츠의 첫 트랜스포터부터 스프린터, 비토를 거쳐 전기 신모델 VLE에 이르는 130년 헤리티지와 신차, 고객 중심 서비스, 디지털 솔루션을 결합해 상용 고객 지원을 강화한다고 밝혔다. 현재 전기 및 내연기관 모델을 아우르는 폭넓은 포트폴리오를 갖추고 있으며, 공장 출고 또는 인증 보디빌더를 통한 차량 커스터마이징이 가능하다. 메르세데스-벤츠 그룹 산하 메르세데스-벤츠 AG는 전 세계 약 164,000명을 고용하고 있으며, 2025년 4개 대륙 약 30개 생산거점에서 승용차와 밴을 합쳐 210만 대 이상을 판매했다.

2026년 지속가능 트럭 부문에서 Volvo FH Aero Electric, DAF XF Electric, IVECO S-Way CNG가 각기 다른 기술로 경쟁하고 있다. Volvo FH Aero Electric은 완충 시 700킬로미터 주행이 가능한 세계 최장 전기 장거리 트럭으로, 후차축 일체형 e-axle 구조와 725kWh 가용 배터리 용량, MCS 급속충전 표준(20~80% 충전 약 50분)을 갖췄다. DAF XF Electric은 유럽 운송업체 100곳으로 구성된 심사단에서 2026년 친환경 트럭상을 수상했으며, PACCAR EX-D1·EX-D2 모터(170~350kW)와 코발트·니켈이 없는 LFP 배터리로 500킬로미터 이상의 무공해 주행거리와 100% 충전에도 내구성을 유지하는 특성이 강점으로 평가됐다. IVECO S-Way CNG는 바이오메탄 호환 액화천연가스 방식으로 3년 연속 지속가능 트럭상을 수상했으며, FPT Industrial의 XCURSOR 13 NG 엔진(500마력, 2,200Nm)을 탑재해 이전 대비 CO2 배출을 최대 8% 줄이고 중량은 10% 가벼워졌다. 세 차량 모두 유럽 중심으로 생산·판매되지만 Volvo와 DAF(PACCAR, Kenworth 연계)는 이미 중남미 시장에서 입지를 다지고 있어 해당 지역 전동화·대체연료 전환에 시사점을 준다.

2026-08-06
만트럭버스가 메가와트 충전 시스템(MCS)을 장착한 전기트럭 양산에 들어갔다고 밝혔다. MCS 시스템을 갖춘 대형트럭을 공장에서 생산하는 유럽 첫 제조사로, 메가와트급 초고속 충전 기술이 실제 현장에 도입된다는 점에서 의미가 크다. MCS는 전기트럭 eTGX·eTGS 모델 기준 최대 750kW급 충전을 지원해 기존 급속충전(CCS) 대비 충전 시간을 크게 줄였으며, 운전자의 의무 휴식 시간에 충전을 마쳐 근무 시간 손실 없이 하루 주행거리 1,000km를 넘길 수 있다. 다만 MCS 충전 인프라가 아직 부족해 당장은 기존 급속충전 시스템을 병행 사용하며, 향후 인프라 확대 시 하드웨어 교체 없이 소프트웨어 업데이트만으로 대응 가능한 구조다. 이번 양산은 유럽 트럭 업계 전반과 메가와트급 충전 인프라 투자 확대에 영향을 미칠 것으로 전망된다.

2026-08-05
최근 프랑스 A36 고속도로 인근에서 완전 위장된 메르세데스-벤츠 트럭 트랙터가 포착됐으며, 후사경과 손잡이, 측면 창 등 디테일로 미루어 벤츠 테스트카로 추정된다. 이 차량은 운전석 위치가 낮으면서도 폭은 약 2.5미터로 넓어 보이는 것이 특징으로, 지난달 프랑스 A9 고속도로 인근에서 포착된 캡 길이가 약 30~40cm 늘어난 위장 Actros와는 다른 콘셉트로 분석된다. EU는 차량 최대 높이를 4미터로 제한하고 있어, 저상 설계는 운전석 높이를 낮춰 캡 내부 폭을 넓히는 데 활용될 수 있으며 이는 지역 운송 및 특수 목적 차량에 적합할 수 있다는 관측이다. EU 지침(2015/719) 9a조는 공기역학, 효율, 안전성 개선과 적재량 증가 없음을 전제로 캡 길이 연장을 허용하고 있으며, 현행 Actros L ProCabin은 이전 세대 대비 전면부가 80mm 길어져 공력 효율을 최대 3% 개선한 사례가 있다. 또한 EU 일반안전규정에 따라 신차는 2026년 1월 7일부터, 기존 차종은 2029년 1월 7일부터 강화된 직접시야 기준을 충족해야 하며, 저상 캡은 근거리 사각지대 축소에도 유리할 수 있어 이번 위장차가 해당 규제 대응 차원일 가능성이 제기된다.

1983년 중국중청(CNHTC)이 오스트리아 슈타이어(Steyr)의 중형 트럭 완성차 제조기술을 도입한 지 43년 만인 2026년 7월 27일, 중국이 개발한 순수전기 트랙터 속표(Sitrak) eTOPAS 600이 오스트리아 슈타이어 공장 생산라인에서 출고되었다. 이 차량은 중국 기업이 제공한 핵심 전기구동 시스템을 탑재하고 오스트리아에서 최종 조립을 완료했으며, 차량 전면에는 슈타이어 오토모티브 로고가 부착된다. 슈타이어 오토모티브는 2021년 설립된 산업 공사로, 속표는 이곳의 제조 역량과 품질 검증을 활용하고 슈타이어는 속표를 통해 새로운 제품과 생산 주문을 확보하는 구조다. 속표 eTOPAS 600은 621kWh 닝더시대 인산철리튬 배터리와 듀얼모터 전기구동 브릿지(지속출력 394kW, 최대출력 692kW)를 탑재하며, 총중량 42톤, 유럽 실차 테스트 기준 약 600km 주행이 가능하다고 밝혔다. 2026년 3월부터 유럽 여러 시장에서 누적 7만km 이상 시험 운행을 진행했으며 평균 전비는 약 0.95kWh/km로, DHL, Gress, Temmel, Lontex 등 대형 고객사가 초기 인수처로 등장했다. 이번 사례는 중국 기업이 단순 부품 공급을 넘어 전기구동, 열관리, 완성차 플랫폼을 제공하며 유럽 현지 제조·공급망·정비 서비스에 직접 참여하는 방향으로 협력 구조가 변화했음을 보여준다.

HRS는 수소 시스템 통합, 저장, 유통, 충전 분야의 전문성을, Baker Hughes는 대용량 수소 응용을 위한 수직형 수소 왕복 압축기 VerHy550 등 산업용 압축 기술을 제공한다. 양사는 이를 결합해 차세대 수소충전소 및 수소충전센터(BHRS-FC)를 개발하고, 에너지 효율, 유지보수, 총소유비용(TCO) 절감, 산업 표준화 등을 최적화할 계획이다. 협력은 비배타적 모델로 프로젝트 단위로 진행되며, 유럽 수소 혁신 지원 프로그램을 활용한 공동 연구개발 가능성도 모색한다. HRS는 하루 300kg에서 4톤까지 모듈형 수소충전소를 제공하며, 연간 최대 180기 생산 능력을 갖춘 생산시설을 운영하고 있다.

2 북미 Asahi Kasei’s Capacity Expansion for Water Electrolysis and...
Asahi Kasei’s Capacity Expansion for Water Electrolysis and...
2026-08-19
Aerial view of the Kawasaki Works
TOKYO --Asahi Kasei’s project to build new facilities for both alkaline water electrolysis and ion-exchange membrane process chlor-alkali electrolysis equipment has been awarded key regional economic incentives. The incentives include financial support from Kanagawa Prefecture and the City of Kawasaki for the facilities being built in Kawasaki, Japan. For Asahi Kasei, a diversified global company, this represents a significant milestone in accelerating its strategic portfolio transformation.
Asahi Kasei is a comprehensive manufacturer and supplier of alkaline water electrolyzers for hydrogen production. The company is building new facilities for both cell frames and membranes for electrolysis at its plant site in Kawasaki, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, targeting a manufacturing capacity of at least 2 GW each by 2028. Together with its current capacity for ion-exchange membrane process chlor-alkali electrolysis equipment, this expansion will raise the company’s total annual capacity for cell frames and membranes to more than 3 GW.
In December 2024, Asahi Kasei’s expansion proposalwas selected for governmental support, reflecting expectations for strengthening industrial competitiveness and regional economic development, including in hydrogen-related markets.In October 2025, Asahi Kasei formally approved plansto construct new production facilities and has since been advancing preparations. This will help strengthen the global clean hydrogen supply base while raising Japan's industrial competitiveness in the field of hydrogen.
Configuration of Asahi Kasei's alkaline water electrolyzer
Positioning its manufacturing site in Kawasaki as a key global hub for both water electrolysis and chlor-alkali systems, Asahi Kasei is concentrating resources there to establish a flexible, resilient supply platform. Backed by the various support initiatives, the company will further expand capacity while contributing to regional economic development.
Looking ahead, Asahi Kasei has stated it will strengthen its technology base and supply capabilities in water electrolysis, while leveraging the complementary strengths of its hydrogen and chlor-alkali operations to build on its global competitiveness.
Asahi Kasei is a diversified global company that contributes to life and living for people around the world. Since its foundation in 1922, with businesses in ammonia and cellulose fiber, Asahi Kasei has consistently grown through proactive portfolio transformation to meet the evolving needs of every age. With 50,000 employees worldwide, the company contributes to sustainability by providing solutions to the world’s challenges across its three business sectors: Healthcare, Homes, and Material. For more information, visithttps://www.asahi-kasei.com/.

3 북미 ABO Energy Sells H2 Hub to Tyczka Hydrogen
ABO Energy Sells H2 Hub to Tyczka Hydrogen
2026-08-19
Wiesbaden -- ABO Energy has sold a hydrogen project – comprising an electrolyser, a hydrogen refuelling station, and a trailer filling station – to Tyczka Hydrogen GmbH. The plant is located in Huenfeld, Germany (Hesse), and has been producing RNFBO-certified green hydrogen for fuel cell busses and lorries since August 2025. RNFBO stands for Renewable Fuel of Non-Biological Origin and refers to advanced fuels that reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
“We have successfully realised this complex project, from the planning stage through to construction and commissioning. We are therefore all the more delighted to have found a strong buyer in Tyczka Hydrogen,” says Dr Karsten Schlageter, Managing Director at ABO Energy.
Following several years of planning and 13 months of construction, ABO Energy inaugurated the project and commissioned it in the summer of 2025. In July 2025, the plant became one of the first in Germany to receive TÜV certification under the CertifHy EU RNFBO Voluntary Scheme for green hydrogen. Since then, the 5-megawatt electrolyser has been producing up to 450 tonnes of hydrogen annually for the 350-bar refuelling station and the hydrogen filling station. The electricity required for this is generated by wind and solar farms. ABO Kraft & Wärme AG has been responsible for operational management since the opening.
The project is being funded as part of the National Innovation Programme for Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Technology with a total of twelve million euros by the German Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport Affairs. Funding for this measure is also being provided as part of the German Recovery and Resilience Plan via the European Recovery and Resilience Facilities (ARF) in the NextGenerationEU programme. The funding guideline is coordinated by NOW GmbH and implemented by Project Management Jülich (PtJ).

14 북미 Small projects lift Home Depot quarterly sales
Small projects lift Home Depot quarterly sales
2026-08-18
Home Depot’s sales improved during its second quarter as customers focused on smaller projects during the summer months with the U.S. housing sector still mired in a slump.
Revenue increased to $47.86 billion from $45.28 billion, edging out the $47.24 billion that Wall Street had expected, according to a survey by FactSet.
Globally, sales at stores open at least a year, a key indicator of a retailer’s health, climbed 1.7%. In the U.S., comparable store sales rose 1.3%.
“We saw broad-based demand across the business as customers continued to engage in smaller projects,” Chief Financial Officer Richard McPhail said in prepared remarks Aug. 18.
Customer transactions slipped 1% in the quarter, but the amount shoppers spent rose to $92.50 per average receipt from $90.01 a year earlier.
Healthy spending on smaller projects during the quarter is encouraging, said Neil Saunders, managing director of GlobalData.
“From our data, the number of smaller projects undertaken during the quarter increased by 1.5% over the prior year,” Saunders said in an email. “This may sound unimpressive, but it represents a step change from the declines of previous periods."
But Saunders also pointed out a potential weakness that is impacting almost all businesses where credit is sometimes required.
“The number of bigger-ticket projects undertaken remains down, falling by 2.1% over last year,” he said. "Concerns around financing and a previous lack of moving activity both remain major drags on the bigger-ticket segment.”
Homeowners that are currently considering taking out loans using home equity are realizing that it is considerably more expensive now compared with the ultra-low rates Americans could count on in the early 2020s. A home project that seemed within reach at a 4% to 5% borrowing rate looks a lot more daunting at 8% or higher.
Existing-home sales decreased by 1.7% in July. Year-over-year sales rose in the Midwest and West, and were flat in the Northeast and South. Learn more:https://t.co/zeDXgcl2nWpic.twitter.com/BOtjCstWSd— National Association of REALTORS® (@nardotrealtor)August 17, 2026
While the average long-term U.S. mortgage rate fell slightly for the first time in six weeks, it is still up from last year and borrowing costs remain steeper than they were a year ago.
The U.S. housing market has been in a slump dating to 2022, the year mortgage rates began climbing from historic lows that fueled a homebuying frenzy at the start of this decade.
Sales of previously occupied U.S. homes slowed again in July as record prices and the highest mortgage rates in a year prove to be an insurmountable hurdle for many prospective buyers. Existing home sales fell 1.7% last month from June, the National Association of Realtors said last week.
Home prices continue to rise and hit unprecedented levels for the month of July, NAR said. The U.S. median sales price increased 2% from a year earlier, to $434,100.
For the three months ended Aug. 2, Home Depot earned $4.77 billion, or $4.79 per share. A year earlier the home improvement retailer earned $4.55 billion, or $4.58 per share.
Excluding one-time items, earnings were $4.92 per share. That’s much better than the $4.73 per share that Wall Street predicted.
Brad Gulick of Eaton Mobile Power Group discusses hydraulic systems that power trucks. He addresses dump pump sizing and more. Tune in above or by going toRoadSigns.ttnews.com.
Home Depot also announced Aug. 18 that it is launching express delivery nationwide. The service will get orders to customers within three hours or less. It will be available for a small flat fee in the U.S., with no subscription or membership required.
The Atlanta company has posted solid back-to-back quarterly performances this year though many Americans have struggled to buy a home. Despite the solid performance, Home Depot stuck with its earlier sales growth guidance for fiscal 2026 of between 2.5% and 4.5%. It also left unchanged its expectations that comparable sales will be flat to up 2%.
Home Depot said that its outlook includes tariff refunds, which are expected to partially offset higher fuel, energy, and other product input costs throughout the year. Last year, the company said that it didn't expect to raise prices because of tariffs, but executive Billy Bastek said at the time that some products that were on Home Depot shelves may disappear.
The company's stock rose 2% before markets opened.
Home Depot ranks No. 54 on the Transport Topics Top 100 list of thelargest private carriers in North America.

17 북미 School’s out for truck driver training program after multiple violations
School’s out for truck driver training program after multiple violations
2026-08-13
A truck driver school in Michigan has been suspended for multiple violations, including providing behind-the-wheel instruction to students without verifying that they had valid commercial learner’s permits.
The Michigan Department of State Driver Education Unit recently announced that it issued asummary suspension to Northern Michigan University Truck Driving Schoolafter an initial investigation found the provider failed to maintain records by law, failed to maintain required student financial records, did not utilize required student written agreements prior to instruction, kept records somewhere other than its established office location and allowed students to sign blank instructional documents that were later completed.
The Northern Michigan University Truck Driving School is located at 1401 Presque Isle Avenue in Marquette, Mich. The Michigan Department of State said that the investigation is ongoing and that no classroom or range instruction may be held during the suspension.
Others who have concerns regarding Northern Michigan University Truck Driving School or another driver education provider in Michigan can file a complaint atMi.gov/DriverEdComplaint.
In July, the U.S. Department of Transportation announced ajoint operation with the U.S. Department of Homeland Securityto stop fraudulent and illegal practices at CDL schools.
The DOT said it has identified about 75 entry-level driver training schools suspected of fraudulent activities, including using improper driver certifications and failing to properly train drivers. DHS’ Homeland Security Investigations will aid the DOT in its reviews of the schools.
“USDOT has spent the last year rooting out bad actors from our trucking industry,” Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said. “We’ve knocked over 24,000 drivers off our roads for failing to speak English, forced states to cancel over 28,000 licenses illegally issued to foreign drivers, and purged over 9,500 unqualified training schools from our FMCSA registry. DHS will be a force multiplier of our efforts to clean up America’s roads.”LL

18 북미 Trucker’s fuel fraud scheme costs company over half a million dollars
Trucker’s fuel fraud scheme costs company over half a million dollars
2026-08-12
A trucker in West Virginia has pleaded guilty to a fuel fraud scheme that cost his employer over half a million dollars.
On Thursday, July 30, the U.S. Attorney’s Office, Southern District of West Virginia, announced that Jeffrey Jeffers, 35, pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud. According to court documents, Jeffers admitted to stealing $510,465.19 from his company through false fuel charges to company-issued credit cards.
Once the transactions were complete, Jeffers would then transfer the funds into an account he owned. Prosecutors said the address listed for the companies was the address of one of Jeffers’ relatives in Canton, Ohio.
Court records show that Jeffers’ truck was fueled at the carrier’s distribution facility in Wood County prior to leaving for his route, but the company provided fuel cards in case of emergency refueling. Despite racking up over half a million in charges, in his plea, Jeffers admitted that his delivery routes typically never required refueling outside of the distribution facility.
Jeffers is scheduled to be sentenced on Nov. 9. He faces a maximum sentence of 20 years in prison, up to three years of supervised release, and a fine of up to $250,000. Jeffers is also ordered to pay $510,465.19 in restitution.LL

19 북미 How does California’s new $3,500 EV rebate work?
How does California’s new $3,500 EV rebate work?
2026-08-10
First-time electric vehicle buyers in California could soon get thousands of dollars off the sticker price. Here’s how to apply.
Thinking about buying or leasing anelectric carin the near future? California will soon be making that cheaper.
On Friday, Gov. Gavin Newsom launched “MyFirstEV,” a new state program that sets aside millions of dollars to fund rebates for residents who buy or lease a zero-emission vehicle — a category that includes battery-electric cars andhydrogen fuel cell-powered vehicles.
First-time EV buyers can qualify for a $3,500 discount when buying or leasing a new electric vehicle, as long as the retail price is under $50,000. If you’re looking for ausedelectric car, there’s still a price reduction available — a smaller one, however: $1,750 off for vehicles retailing for under $25,000.
The state’s program comes a year after President Donald Trump’s massive spending and tax plan known as the One Big Beautiful Billendedfederal tax credits for EVs nationwide. Previously, American consumers could claim a $7,500 tax credit after buying a new EV or $4,000 for used EVs.
When announcing the program in July, Newsom said that as the federal government pulls back from supporting EVs, California would instead be “putting its foot on the accelerator” — and that the instant rebate program would “[make] it easier for families to drive clean, breathe clean and keep more money in their pockets.”
The program has secured $270 million in funding — half of that from the state budget and the other from participating EV automakers.
Only California residents who are buying or leasing an EV for the first time are eligible for this rebate.
And consumers will have to confirm that this is the first time they are buying or leasing an EV before taking their car home, said Lindsay Buckley, communications director of the California Air Resources Board, the agency tasked with managing the program.
“Participants will be required to sign a legal document declaring that this is in fact their first purchase or lease of an electric vehicle,” she said.
“So if you’ve already bought or leased an electric vehicle in the past, then you wouldn’t be eligible for this program.”
Limiting the program to first-time buyers could actually help boost the popularity of EVs among people who have never bought them, said Scott Moura, a UC Berkeley professor of civil engineering.
“Providing incentive to people who have bought EVs before isn’t really adding to the number of people who purchase EVs,” he said. “The funds can be used most effectively if they’re targeted towards first-time EV buyers.”
No — there’s no application to fill out ahead of time. All you need to do is go to a dealership of one of the15 participating automakers.
Hyundai, Lucid and Tesla rebates are available starting today. The other participants will launch their programs throughout the fall.
This is different from other past state rebate programs — like the now-terminatedElectric Bicycle Incentive Program— which have required participants to fill out an applicationbeforemaking a purchase.
If you move forward with making a purchase or lease, confirm two things with the salesperson and the financing team:
When federal EV rebates were available, buyers had to initially wait until they filed their taxes the year after buying their car to request this money back. But state officials say that folks interested in the FirstEV discount won’t have to wait so long.
“Californians will be able to go down to participating automakers’ dealerships and access the rebates at the point of sale,” Buckley said. “They won’t have any delay in getting this discount.”
No — MyFirstEV discounts will only cover battery-electric cars and hydrogen fuel cell-powered vehicles from automakers participating in the program.
Hybrid vehicles are also not included in MyFirstEV, state officials confirmed with KQED.
There’s also a price limit: The EV you choose must cost under $50,000 if it’s a new car, and $25,000 if it’s used.
There is, however, asmall exceptionto this price rule if the automaker is headquartered in California — in which case the discounts will apply regardless of the manufacturer’s retail price.
More than adozen electric car brandsare based in the Golden State, with several selling models priced beyond the $50,000 limit.
While the MyFirstEV discount will not vary based on income, consumers can stack the discount with other incentive programs, including theDriving Clean Assistance ProgramandClean Cars 4 All.
To qualify for Clean Cars 4 All, residents must have an income of less than or equal to 300% of the federal poverty level. This program could unlock up to $12,000 in additional savings.
No — funds will be divided equally among the participating automakers.
However, there may be greater demand for some brands, which could mean that rebates may run out faster at some dealerships.
This article includes reporting from KQED’sLaura Klivans.

20 북미 EEOC claims trucking school discriminated against females
EEOC claims trucking school discriminated against females
2026-08-10
Female student drivers allege they were subjected to unlawful policies and practices, according to a discrimination lawsuit filed against a trucking school operating in Texas and Mississippi.
In this claim, the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission said the “overtly discriminatory training conditions” at KLLM Driving Academy Inc., a subsidiary of KLLM Transport Services, date back to at least January 2021.
The EEOC said that among these conditions was the trucking school’s decision to adopt the male trainers’ decision to opt out of training female student drivers instead of providing separate sleeping quarters during training.
This delayed the start of training for female students, the EEOC claimed in the lawsuit.
“Rather than provide the female student drivers’ single-sex sleeping quarters that protected their privacy and ensured equal employment opportunity, the employer here instead decided to adopt a series of sex-based discriminatory policies that treated women trainees worse than male trainees and disadvantaged them in their employment opportunities, which is unlawful disparate treatment,” acting EEOC General Counsel Catherine Eschbach said.
KLLM Driving Academy also mandated that female student drivers willing to receive instruction from male trainers be required to notify their sponsors or partners before training could begin, according to the lawsuit.
“Under federal law, all workers in the United States have a right to be given a fair opportunity to succeed based on their knowledge, skills and effort, not their sex,” EEOC Dallas District Office Director Travis Nicholson said. “That fundamental principle applies to all aspects of their jobs, including training and other terms and conditions of employment.”
The EEOC said the trucking school’s conduct violates the Civil Rights Act of 1964, prohibiting sex discrimination in employment.
Following an attempt to reach a pre-litigation settlement, the EEOC filed the lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas, Dallas Division.
According to that lawsuit, Central Transport, based in Warren, Mich., routinely turned down qualified women truck drivers at terminals across the nation.
Allegations at this trucking company go back at least a decade.
Central Transport must pay $5.5 million in backpay, lost benefits, interest and compensatory damages, according to the settlement.LL

21 북미 It’s down to 11 for 2026 Transition Trucking award
It’s down to 11 for 2026 Transition Trucking award
2026-08-10
Motor carriers, training schools, private fleets and individuals from across the country submitted nominations for the 2026 Transition Trucking: Driving for Excellence award.
From those nominations, a group of semifinalists has been determined.
TheTransition Trucking awardwas established in 2016 to honor the achievements of military veterans making the transition to the trucking industry
This program is made possible through a partnership between Fastport, Kenworth and the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation’s Hiring Our Heroes initiative.
“The Transition Trucking award campaign continues to spotlight the extraordinary contributions veterans are making in the transportation industry while introducing a new generation of service members to the real economic opportunities a trucking career can offer,” said Eric Eversole, president of Hiring Our Heroes and a vice president of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce. “As we celebrate the program’s 11th year, we’re proud to honor this remarkable Elite 11 and the decade of veteran success they represent.”
For the 11th consecutive year, the winner of the Transition Trucking award will be handed the keys to a newKenworthT680.
“This year’s semifinalists exemplify the dedication, leadership and commitment to service that military veterans bring to the trucking industry,” said Kyle Kimball, Kenworth director of marketing. “Kenworth is honored to celebrate 11 years of partnership with Fastport and the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation’s Hiring Our Heroes initiative, and we look forward to recognizing this exceptional class of semifinalists.”

ACCIONA advances decarbonization at the Port of Valencia with hydrogen technology
ACCIONA is testing a high-capacity hydrogen-powered electric generator at the North Terminal works at the Port of Valencia to reduce emissions and replace fossil fuels in construction machinery. The initiative, already operational on site, will continue in the validation phase until mid-June.
The equipment, developed by French company INOCEL, is based on a 200 kW hydrogen fuel cell and is being used to supply power to a tower crane involved in the KUGIRA caisson dock operations, which are focused on manufacturing the project’s concrete caissons.
In this type of environment, where access to the power grid is not always available, the usual solution would have been to use a diesel generator. However, using diesel would involve high fuel consumption and the emission of around 80 metric tons of CO₂ equivalent during the test period.
What makes this initiative particularly innovative is the equipment’s power capacity, which makes it possible to test hydrogen technology in construction machinery with high energy requirements. This solution opens the door to new alternatives for reducing the use of conventional fuels, especially at sites without a direct connection to the power grid.
The initiative marks progress in the deployment of zero-emission technologies in real-world construction environments and contributes to the decarbonization of ACCIONA’s operations. It is part of the company’s efforts to incorporate innovative energy solutions that help reduce the use of conventional fuels on construction sites and further advance that transition.

23 북미 LG Chem Doubles Lifespan of Key Electrode for Green Hydrogen
LG Chem Doubles Lifespan of Key Electrode for Green Hydrogen
2026-08-09
LG Chem Doubles Lifespan of Key Electrode for Green Hydrogen
PEM Water Electrolysis Electrode Gains Performance and DurabilityResults Published in Nature Communications
LG Chem (051910.KS) has developed a polymer electrolyte membrane (PEM) water electrolysis electrode technology that enables stable, long-term hydrogen production using only a small amount of iridium, raising the prospects for commercializing next-generation green hydrogen production materials.
LG Chem said on the 26th that a research team at its Basic Technology Research Institute, under the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), has developed an interface stabilization technology that dramatically improves the performance and durability of PEM water electrolysis electrodes.
The research, which involved a team led by Ko Jae-hyun, a senior researcher at the Korea Institute of Science and Technology (KIST), was published on the 21st in Nature Communications, one of the world’s top-tier academic journals.
Green hydrogen is a key energy source for realizing a decarbonized society, produced by splitting water using electricity generated from renewable energy. PEM water electrolysis is regarded as a next-generation green hydrogen production technology, based on its high hydrogen productivity and superior output responsiveness.
However, PEM water electrolysis devices use expensive rare-metal iridium catalysts, making economic viability a major challenge. In particular, when less iridium is used in the electrode, performance deteriorates during long-term operation. Shorter equipment replacement cycles and rising operating costs have been the biggest obstacles to expanding the commercialization of PEM water electrolysis technology.
LG Chem solved these problems with a catalyst interface stabilization technology that applies an atomic-level coating layer to the surface of the iridium catalyst. As a result, it succeeded in extending stable hydrogen production time by more than twofold compared with before, while reducing iridium usage by more than half from previous levels.
In addition, LG Chem completed the manufacturing and performance verification of large electrodes based on its own electrode fabrication technology, confirming the potential for mass production and commercialization.
Shim Kyu-seok,Executive Vice President and CTO of LG Chem, said:
This research achievement is a case in which LG Chem’s materials technology competitiveness has been recognized worldwide,
“We will continue to expand various research and development efforts to secure competitiveness in next-generation hydrogen production technology.”

25 북미 No more restroom runarounds for New Hampshire truckers
No more restroom runarounds for New Hampshire truckers
2026-08-06
Most workers can use a restroom without asking. Too many truck drivers still have to ask. Some are told “no.”
Truckers keep shelves stocked. They keep freight moving. Yet some are denied a restroom while picking up or delivering a load.
Washington was the first state to take on the problem. A2023 lawrequires shippers, receivers and terminal operators to provide restroom access.
Now, afederal billwould bring those protections to truck drivers across the country.
TheOwner-Operator Independent Drivers Associationhas supported what it calls a commonsense solution for years.
Truck drivers should not have to search for a restroom while doing the job that keeps America moving.
Truckers should never have to ‘hold it’ because they aren’t allowed to use the restroom. It’s a matter of basic dignity. 🚛🚻 For months, OOIDA worked with@RepHoulahanand@RepTroyNehlsto get restroom access into the new highway bill. THANK YOU for listening to our members!…pic.twitter.com/KTXZDt1MgR
— Owner-Operator Independent Drivers Association (@OOIDA)May 21, 2026
Starting Tuesday, Aug. 11, businesses in New Hampshire can no longer turn truck drivers away from restrooms.
Gov. Kelly Ayotte signed a law requiring businesses to allow truckers to use existing restrooms during deliveries and pickups.
Supporters said too many drivers are denied access. Others simply do not want truck drivers using their facilities.
Rep. Henry Giasson, R-Goffstown, said restroom access is one of the biggest concerns he hears from female truck drivers.
Truckers help keep businesses running. Giasson said allowing them to use a restroom is the least businesses can do.
The lawapplies to most public-facing businesses. It also covers shippers, receivers, factories, warehouses, distribution centers and other loading sites.
Businesses will not have to build new restrooms. They only have to allow truck drivers to use restrooms already available to workers or customers.
Rep. Greg Hill, R-Merrimack, said it is hard to believe lawmakers had to step in.
“I just can’t believe in this day and age that someone is refusing restrooms to another person. I think it’s important that we send a strong signal with this one,” Hill said.
The law includes limits to protect businesses.
Access can be denied if allowing a driver inside would create a health, safety or security risk.
Fuel stations and restaurants with employee-only restrooms are still exempt.
It’s crazy that restroom access keeps popping up, but here we are.
New Hampshire just passed a law giving truck drivers a basic human right they are too often denied.👉https://t.co/tFWrgDOQSZpic.twitter.com/RXCXBztTu0
— Land Line Magazine (@Land_Line_Mag)June 23, 2026
The New Hampshire Motor Transport Association supported the bill.
Bob Sculley is the group’s president. He called restroom access a matter of basic respect.
If a business provides a restroom for employees or customers, he said truck drivers making deliveries should be able to use it too.
OOIDA said the law addresses a problem drivers face every day.
Executive Vice President Lewie Pugh said using a restroom should not turn into a fight.
“But way too often, professional drivers are told no when they ask to use a restroom while picking up or delivering cargo,” Pugh said.
The new law also protects drayage truck drivers working at ports and rail yards.
Drivers must have access to safe restrooms or portable toilets where they are allowed to work.
Terminal operators must provide enough facilities to meet demand.
If long restroom lines become a problem, more facilities must be added.
Operators must also provide parking so drivers have a safe place to stop while using the restroom.LL

How Hyundai Motor Has Reimagined the FIFA World Cup™ Experience Through Mobility, Technology and Innovation

From global fan engagement campaigns and record-breaking mobility fleets to breakthrough robotics demonstrations, Hyundai Motor's 27-year partnership with FIFA has evolved far beyond traditional sponsorship, transforming the FIFA World Cup™ experience through mobility, innovation and technology.
While the world's top footballers battled for glory at theFIFA World Cup 2026™, it was a humanoid robot that pulled off the tournament’s most unexpected viral moment. During halftime of a Round of 16 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium,Boston Dynamics' humanoid robotAtlas®emerged from the player tunnel, performed a series of iconic goal celebrations and delivered the ceremonial match ball to the referee.
The activation quickly became one of Hyundai Motor's most recognizable FIFA World Cup™ moments. Behind the scenes,The Training Ground— a documentary-style film showcasing Atlas' preparation — generated more than 16 million views on YouTube.Spot®also featured during the tournament, autonomously monitoring key facilities including the International Broadcast Center in Dallas, highlighting Hyundai Motor Group's growing robotics capabilities and vision for future mobility.
Together, these moments reflected the evolution of Hyundai Motor's nearly three-decade partnership with FIFA—from an automotive sponsorship into a global platform for mobility, innovation and fan engagement.
Spot® patrols key operational sites during the FIFA World Cup 2026™, showcasing the robotics capabilities of Hyundai Motor Group and Boston Dynamics.
A 27-Year Partnership on Football's Biggest Stage
Since 1999, Hyundai Motor has been a FIFA Partner, the highest tier within FIFA's sponsorship structure. The 27-year relationship remains the longest sponsorship tenure in the automotive sector and ranks among FIFA's longest-running commercial partnerships. The company secured the rights in 1999 following the introduction of FIFA's automotive sponsorship category, with an agreement covering 13 FIFA competitions and providing a platform for global growth and brand recognition.
Hyundai Motor made its debut as an official FIFA partner at the 1999 FIFA Women's World Cup in the United States. As FIFA tournaments expanded in scale and reach, so did the company's visibility. By the 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™, the Hyundai Motor brand was exposed globally for an average of 15 minutes per match across all 64 matches, demonstrating the marketing power of football's biggest stage and helping establish Hyundai Motor among the world's leading automotive brands.
Officials pose for a commemorative photo at the announcement ceremony of Hyundai Motor Company's official partnership with the 2002 FIFA World Cup™ in 1999, including Honorary Chairman Mong-Koo Chung (third from right). The Fleet Behind Football's Biggest Stage
The Fleet Behind Football's Biggest Stage
FIFA tournaments have long provided a platform for Hyundai Motor to showcase the evolution of its mobility technologies. Fromhydrogen fuel cell vehicles and busesat the 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™ to 226 battery electric vehicles (BEVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) deployed as part of the official fleet at FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022™ —one of the largest deployments of electrified vehiclesin FIFA World Cup™ history — the company has consistently used the tournament to demonstrate its mobility innovations.
At FIFA World Cup 2026™, Hyundai Motor supplied 994 passenger vehicles and 506 buses across the United States, Canada and Mexico, representing thelargest official vehicle fleet everdeployed for a FIFA World Cup tournament.
Hyundai Motor’s Tucson Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle and hydrogen fuel cell bus demonstrated for the FIFA World Cup Germany 2006™ Organizing Committee.
Bringing Fans Closer to the FIFA World Cup™
Beyond mobility, Hyundai Motor has consistently used its FIFA partnership to bring fans closer to the tournament and transform how they experience the FIFA World Cup™.
One of Hyundai Motor's earliest global fan engagement initiatives was theGoodwill Ball Road Tour, launched ahead of the 2002 FIFA World Cup Korea/Japan™. The campaign featured 32 giant footballs that traveled across participating countries, inviting supporters to leave messages of encouragement for their national teams.
The Goodwill Ball Road Tour ahead of the 2002 FIFA World Cup Korea/Japan™, one of Hyundai Motor’s earliest global fan engagement initiatives.
At the 2010 FIFA World Cup South Africa™, Hyundai Motor expanded that concept through theOne Million Dream Balls for Africainitiative, which pledged one million footballs to underprivileged children and youth across Africa through customer and fan participation. The balls were distributed through UN-affiliated organizations and NGOs.
First introduced in 2006,Hyundai Goal of the Tournamenthas become one of Hyundai Motor's signature FIFA World Cup™ programs, allowing fans to vote for the tournament's best goal. At the 2018 FIFA World Cup Russia™, Benjamin Pavard's strike against Argentina received more than three million votes.
Hyundai Motor further strengthened the connection between players and supporters throughBe There With Hyundai (BTWH), which invites fans to contribute messages and slogans for their national teams to be displayed on Official National Team Buses. For FIFA World Cup 2026™, the program evolved into a global children's artwork initiative, inspiring a new generation of fans through football.
The Official National Team Bus provided to the Korea Republic national team during the 2010 FIFA World Cup South Africa™.
Bringing Football Heritage Beyond the Stadium
As Hyundai Motor's FIFA partnership evolved, the company created new ways for fans to experience football history and culture beyond matchday, connecting football's past, present and future.
Hyundai Motor's collaboration with the FIFA Museum began at the 2018 FIFA World Cup Russia™, whereThe History Makersexhibition attracted more than 94,000 visitors. The initiative continued at FIFA

OMV receives EUR 450 mn loan from the European Investment Bank for its 140 MW green hydrogen production facility

OMV receives EUR 450 mn loan from the European Investment Bank for its 140 MW green hydrogen production facility
Vienna, July 13, 2026 – The European Investment Bank (“EIB”) has granted a EUR 450 million loan to support the construction of OMV’s green hydrogen production plant, which is set to significantly contribute to the decarbonization of the Schwechat refinery in Lower Austria.
With a total investment of EUR 600 million, this 140 MW plant in Bruck an der Leitha is currently under construction and scheduled to commence operations by the end of 2027. Using renewable energy, OMV will produce up to 23,000 tons of green hydrogen per year.
The new facility will enable the local production of green hydrogen and significantly enhance the sustainability of fuel and chemical products at OMV’s Schwechat refinery. OMV estimates an annual reduction of approximately 150,000 tons of carbon emissions*, corresponding to approximately 10 percent of the Schwechat refinery’s current direct emissions.
Reinhard Florey,Deputy Chairman of the Executive Board and Chief Financial Officer of OMV, said:
The European Investment Bank’s loan commitment is a strong signal of confidence in OMV’s transformation strategy and our ability to deliver large-scale projects that drive industrial decarbonization,
“Producing green hydrogen in Austria enables us to increase the captive use of more sustainable energy in our production and for our innovative products. The construction of one of Europe’s largest green hydrogen plants marks a major milestone in the decarbonization of our industrial processes and underscores our ambition to actively shape the energy transition in Austria and beyond.”
EIB Vice-PresidentKarl Nehammer,during the site visit, said:
Green hydrogen is a cornerstone of Europe’s transition to a competitive, climate-neutral and secure energy system,
“By supporting green hydrogen production at industrial scale, we are strengthening Europe’s competitiveness, reinforcing our energy security and helping decarbonise refining by replacing fossil-based hydrogen with renewable hydrogen. This investment also lays the foundation for the future production of sustainable aviation fuels, supporting the EU’s climate and energy security objectives.”
Under OMV Strategy 2030, the company focuses on capturing market growth for renewable fuels and sustainable chemical feedstock and aims at a production capacity of approximately 900 kilotons by 2030. Key assets already in operation include a co‑processing plant and a 10 MW green hydrogen facility at the Schwechat refinery in Austria. Projects currently under execution include a Sustainable Aviation Fuel/Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil plant at the OMV Petrom Petrobrazi refinery, as well as additional 20 MW and 35 MW green hydrogen projects in Romania, operated by OMV Petrom, and the 140 MW green hydrogen plant under construction in Austria. Together, these investments support OMV’s ambition to achieve net‑zero emissions by 2050.

트럭 배출 규제와 연방 보조금이 사라지면서 전기 상용차 시장이 선별적 국면에 진입하고 있다. ACT Research에 따르면 연방 세액공제가 폐지되면 많은 전기 트럭 활용 사례가 경제성 측면에서 불리해지며, 야드 트랙터와 라스트마일 배송 차량이 여전히 가장 적합한 분야로 남아있다. 북미 클래스 6~8 신규 트럭 판매에서 배터리 전기차 비중은 1% 미만이지만, 라스트마일 배송, 항만·도어레이지, 지자체 차량 등 특정 운영 분야에서는 채택이 지속되고 있다. FedEx Freight와 Volvo Trucks 등은 예측 가능한 노선과 안정적 충전 인프라를 갖춘 애플리케이션에 맞춰 전기차를 도입하고 있으며, Volvo는 ACT Expo 2026에서 차세대 VNL Electric을 공개하고 EV 딜러망을 33개 주와 캐나다 4개 주 84개 지점으로 확대했다. 배터리 가격 하락과 효율 개선이 이루어지지 않는 한 2026~2027년까지 전기 트럭 판매는 정체될 것으로 전망되며, 일부 운송업체는 탈탄소화를 위해 바이오디젤과 재생디젤 등 대안 연료로 눈을 돌리고 있다.

4 북미 토크, 자율주행 트럭 보안 강화를 위해 Auto-ISAC 가입
Torc joins Auto-ISAC to boost autonomous truck security

자율주행 트럭 기업 토크 로보틱스가 자동차 산업의 글로벌 사이버보안 협력 기구인 Auto-ISAC에 가입했다. 이번 가입은 상용화를 앞두고 안전하고 견고한 자율주행 시스템 구축이라는 회사의 방침을 뒷받침한다. 토크는 Auto-ISAC을 통해 자동차 제조사, 부품업체, 상용차 관련 조직과 사이버 위협 정보를 공유하고 모범 사례 마련에 참여할 계획이다. 토크 관계자들은 사이버보안이 설계 단계부터 반영돼야 하며 안전, 보안, 신뢰성, 운영 전반에 걸친 엔지니어링이 필요하다고 강조했다. Auto-ISAC 측은 단일 조직이 진화하는 사이버 위협에 홀로 대응할 수 없다며, 토크의 가입이 업계 전반의 위협 정보 공유 체계를 강화할 것이라고 평가했다.

코디악 AI는 2분기에 무인 트럭 7대를 추가 배치해 고객 보유 차량대수를 35대로 늘렸으며, 연내 무인 장거리 운송 상용화를 목표로 하고 있다. 회사는 7세대 코디악 드라이버 플랫폼을 공개했으며, 자율주행 준비도는 7월 기준 91%로 상승했다. 7세대 플랫폼은 이전 세대 대비 성능이 약 50% 향상됐고, 더 컴팩트하고 모듈화된 설계로 저비용 데이케이브 구성을 지원하며 센서 포드 수명도 늘어났다. AI 기반 시뮬레이션 기술 브레이크포인트는 시간당 100만 건 이상의 시뮬레이션을 건당 약 0.1센트 비용으로 수행한다. 2분기 누적 유상 운행 시간은 40,000시간을 넘어 1분기 대비 71% 증가했고, 화물 운송량은 300,000톤을 넘어 누적 운송 건수가 20,000건을 돌파했다. 2분기 매출은 전분기 대비 91% 증가한 350만 달러를 기록했으나 영업현금 3,410만 달러를 사용했고 잉여현금흐름은 -3,810만 달러였으며, 기말 현금 및 유가증권은 1억 5,110만 달러였다.

MBL은 8개 정규 노선과 통근·교통약자 이동 서비스를 통해 연간 약 300만 건의 이용객을 실어나르고 있으며, 신규 수소버스는 빠른 충전과 긴 주행거리, 무배출 운행이 장점으로 하루 전체 운행이 가능하다. 각 FCEB는 연간 약 52톤의 이산화탄소 배출을 절감하며, 이는 미국 산림 48에이커가 흡수하는 탄소량과 맞먹는다. 도입을 위해 임시 및 영구 수소 충전소를 준비하고 정비시설을 개선하고 있으며, 연방교통청(FTA) 도시권역 공식지원 프로그램의 자금 지원을 받고 있다. 몬테벨로는 이 정도 규모로 수소 FCEB와 충전 인프라를 도입하는 미국 내 최초의 중소형 교통기관 중 하나이며, 비영리기관 CTE가 기술 지원과 프로젝트 관리를 맡고 있다.

Daimler Truck North America는 미국 내 신규 제조시설 건립을 검토 중이며 연내 착공, 2029년 가동을 목표로 한다. 한편 브로커 제시 스팟 운임은 4주 연속 하락해 마일당 평균 3.32달러를 기록했으며, 전미 평균 고속도로용 경유 가격은 갤런당 5.35~5.37달러로 상승했다.

일리노이주 제12선거구를 지역구로 둔 마이크 보스트 하원의원이 하원 휴회 기간 동안 이해관계자들을 모아 트럭 주차난 해결 방안을 논의했다. 인터스테이트 57번 렌드 레이크 휴게소는 하루 15,000대 이상의 트럭이 지나가지만 야간에는 주차 공간이 크게 부족한 상황이며, 인근 소도시 웨스트시티에서도 월마트 등 민간 부지의 주차 제한으로 트럭 기사들이 안전한 주차 공간을 찾는 데 어려움을 겪고 있다. 일리노이 교통국은 포트 매사크 휴게소 주차 공간을 18개에서 64개로 확장하는 프로젝트에 보조금을 받았으며, I-64, I-70, I-57, I-55 등 추가 확장도 검토 중이다. 참석자들은 여성 운전자들이 트럭 정류장보다 편의시설과 조명이 잘 갖춰진 휴게소를 선호한다는 점, 일리노이주 도로기금 70억 달러가 충분히 집행되지 않고 있다는 점도 지적했다. 보스트 의원이 6년 전 발의한 트럭 주차 안전 개선법은 향후 5년간 7억 5,000만 달러를 무료 주차 확장 프로젝트에만 지원하는 내용으로, 실현 가능성이 그 어느 때보다 높아졌다.

미국 미시간주 오번힐스에 본사를 둔 연료 시스템 공급업체 Phinia가 경상용차(LCV)용 수소 내연기관(H2ICE)으로 유럽 최초 인증을 획득했다. 사우디아라비아 에너지기업 Aramco와 공동 개발한 이 차량은 2027년 11월 29일부터 신규 LCV 차종에, 2029년 11월 29일부터는 모든 신규 LCV 등록에 의무화되는 유로 7 배출가스 규제를 충족한다. Phinia는 기존 내연기관 구조를 비교적 적은 개조로 수소 연료에 맞게 전환할 수 있음을 입증했다고 밝혔다. 이 차량은 기존 디젤 밴 대비 배기가스 CO2 배출을 최대 99% 줄이면서 최대 500km의 주행거리를 제공한다.

11 북미 다임러트럭, 북미 트럭 사업 전망 개선에 힘입어 2026 회계연도 실적 가이던스 상향

미국에서 주 간 운송에 종사하는 상용차 운전자는 연방법에 따라 공중과 소통하고 도로 표지판을 이해하며 단속관 질의에 응답할 수 있는 영어 능력을 갖춰야 하며, 이 규정은 1936년부터 존재해왔으나 집행 강도가 시기별로 달랐다. 2025년 6월 25일부터 FMCSA는 영어 능력 미달을 운행정지(out-of-service) 사유로 다시 복원했으며, 이는 영구적 면허 취소가 아니라 문제 해결 전까지 운행을 금지하는 조치다. 언론에서 언급된 약 2만 3천 명이라는 수치는 특정 인원이 영구 퇴출된 것이 아니라 2025~2026년 누적된 영어 능력 및 도로표지 관련 위반·정지 기록 건수(2만 7천여 건)를 의미하며, 동일 운전자가 중복 집계될 수 있다. 2026년 3월 16일부터는 비이민 상업운전면허 발급 기준이 강화되어 H-2A, H-2B, E-2 등 특정 비자 유형으로 제한되며, FMCSA는 기존 면허 소지자 약 20만 명 중 19만 4천 명이 화물 운송 시장에서 점차 퇴출될 것으로 추산했다. 이에 따라 외국인 운전자에게는 합법적 취업 신분, CDL 자격 취득, 통역 없이 현장 대응 가능한 영어 능력, 관련 교육·대기·법규 준수 비용까지 종합적으로 고려한 진입 장벽이 커지고 있다.

13 북미 무인 대형 트럭 28대, 45만 톤 모래 운반... 화물차 기사 위기인가?
28辆无人重卡拉了45万吨砂 卡友危了？
2026-08-06
미국 퍼미안 분지에서 운행 중인 무인 트럭 차량대는 안전 요원 없이 15개 노선에서 약 7,000회 운송을 수행하며 45만 톤 이상의 프래킹용 모래를 운반했다. Atlas Energy Solutions와 Kodiak의 협력 프로젝트는 2024년 12월 무인 대형 트럭 2대의 상업 운송 시작 이후 2026년 3월 31일 기준 28대로 확대됐고 노선도 15개로 늘었다. 2026년 1분기에만 차량대는 23,500시간 이상의 무인 운행을 완료했으며, 7월 20일에는 하루 176회 모래 운송을 기록해 프로젝트 가동 18개월 만의 최고치를 세웠다. 양사는 견인차와 3단 트레일러를 연결해 총중량 135톤을 초과하는 조합도 시험했다. Atlas는 14개 프래킹 모래 생산시설(연산 약 2,900만 톤), 120대 규모의 트럭 차량대, 42마일 길이의 전동 컨베이어벨트 등을 보유하며 운송 전 과정을 강하게 통제하고 있어, 화물·노선·상하차가 표준화된 환경이 무인 운송 확장에 유리한 조건으로 작용했다. Kodiak은 오데사에 약 1.67만 제곱미터 규모의 서비스 시설을 두고 있으며, 2025년 1월 기준 직원 12명에서 1분기 말까지 약 20명으로 확대할 계획이었다. 한편 2024년 7월 해당 유전 지역 프래킹 모래 운송 기사들이 임금과 하역 지연, 위생시설 부족에 항의해 대규모 파업을 벌인 지 수 주 만에 Atlas가 자율주행 트럭 시범 운행을 발표한 배경도 함께 언급됐다.

DTNA는 80년 이상 미국에서 상용차를 생산해왔으며, 현재 노스캐롤라이나와 사우스캐롤라이나의 여러 공장과 오리건주 포틀랜드 본사 및 엔지니어링 센터를 운영하고 있다.

Daimler Truck North America(DTNA)는 미국 내 신규 그린필드 제조시설 건설 계획을 발표하며 북미 상용차 시장에 대한 자신감을 나타냈다. 이 시설은 첨단 생산기술과 유연한 제조 시스템을 갖춰 사업용 및 온하이웨이 차량 생산 역량을 확대할 예정이다. DTNA는 현재 공급망, 숙련 인력, 물류 인프라, 사업 환경 등을 고려해 복수의 후보지를 검토 중이며, 부지 선정 후 2026년 말 착공해 2029년 가동을 목표로 한다. 이 시설은 장기적으로 수천 개의 일자리를 창출할 것으로 예상되며, DTNA는 현재 노스캐롤라이나와 사우스캐롤라이나 지역에 다수의 생산 공장을 운영하고 있다. 7 북미 DTNA, 2029년 미국 신규 트럭 생산공장 가동 예정
DTNA to open new U.S. truck manufacturing plant in 2029
2026-08-06
Daimler Truck North America(DTNA)는 수요 증가에 대응해 2029년 가동을 목표로 미국 내 신규 트럭 생산공장을 건설할 계획이라고 8월 6일 밝혔으며, 건설은 2026년 말 착공 예정이다. 부지는 아직 확정되지 않았지만 노스캐롤라이나 등 미국 남동부가 유력하며, 완공 시 DTNA의 미국 내 최대 생산시설이 될 전망이다. 이는 7월 말 발표된 오리건주 포틀랜드 Swan Island 공장의 10월 30일 폐쇄와 맞물려, Western Star X-Series와 Freightliner eCascadia·eM2 생산을 노스·사우스캐롤라이나로 이전하는 생산망 최적화 전략의 일환이다. DTNA는 Mount Holly 공장에서 지난해 감원된 인력 400명을 복귀시키고 2026년 말까지 200명을 추가 채용할 계획이다. CEO John O'Leary는 이번 결정이 관세 정책이 아닌 장기 시장점유율 확대 전략에 따른 것이라고 강조했으며, Daimler Truck은 2026년 시장 수요 개선을 반영해 DTNA의 연간 판매 가이던스를 160,000~180,000대로 상향 조정했다.

6월 중고 대형(Class 8) 트럭 판매가 화물 운송 여건 개선과 재고 부족 지속에 힘입어 강세를 보였다. ACT Research에 따르면 판매량은 전년 대비 10.2% 증가한 24,900대를 기록했으며, 전월 대비로는 4.6% 늘어난 23,800대에서 상승했다. 평균 소매 판매가는 전년 대비 1.5% 오른 61,751달러, 전월 대비 2% 상승했고 평균 주행거리는 410,000마일로 늘었다. J.D. Power는 경매 채널을 중심으로 전반적인 가격 강세가 나타났다고 밝혔으며, 스팟 운임이 4년 만에 처음으로 계약 운임을 상회하고 Class 8 제조사들이 지난해 감원했던 공장 인력을 재고용한 점을 주요 요인으로 꼽았다. RB Global 데이터에 따르면 스팟 운임은 2023~2025년 2달러 미만에서 벗어나 현재 마일당 3달러를 상회하며, 2020년식 Freightliner Cascadia 등 특정 차량 가치도 상승했다. 업계 전문가들은 신차 판매 회복에도 불구하고 과거 공급 부족 누적 영향으로 중고차 시장 재고 부족이 연말까지 이어지며 가격을 지지할 것으로 전망했다.

6 북미 탱커·트레일러 세척이 세제보다 과학에 가까운 이유
Why washing a tank or trailer is more science than soap

겉보기에 깨끗한 식품용 탱커나 냉장 트레일러라도 세척과 살균이 제대로 이루어지지 않으면 밀가루, 유제품, 농산물 등 식품 화물을 오염시킬 수 있는 미생물이 표면에 남아 있을 수 있다. 궬프대학교 식품과학 교수 키스 워리너는 세척과 살균은 다른 개념이며, 세척은 눈에 보이는 잔여물을 제거하는 것이고 살균은 남아 있는 미생물을 비활성화하는 과정이라고 설명한다. 2015년 밀가루 관련 대장균 발병 사례는 제대로 세척되지 않은 벌크 탱커가 오염원이 될 수 있음을 보여주었으며, 이에 따라 이물질 제거, 헹굼, 화물에 맞는 세제 선택, 재헹굼, 살균, 최종 헹굼 및 건조로 이어지는 다단계 세척 절차가 정착됐다. 세균은 스테인리스강이나 알루미늄 표면의 미세한 흠집에 붙어 바이오필름을 형성해 살균제에 저항성을 갖게 되므로, 표면 손상을 피하고 정기적인 위생 관리를 유지하는 예방이 핵심이라고 강조한다. 캐나다 해밀턴 소재 Tandet의 세척 및 컨테이너 서비스 총괄 존 앵거는 식품등급 탱크 세척이 고객 승인 표준운영절차에 따라 엄격히 관리되며, 세척 완료 후에는 봉인 번호와 세척 이력이 기록된 증명서를 발급해 공급망 전반의 추적성을 보장한다고 밝혔다.

U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index에 따르면 2분기 동안 트럭 운송 능력이 계속 타이트해지면서 화물 물동량은 감소했음에도 운송 지출은 오히려 증가했다. 전국 물동량 지수는 전분기 대비 1.1%, 전년 대비 2.8% 감소한 반면, 지출 지수는 전분기 대비 6.4%, 전년 대비 28.1% 상승했다. U.S. Bank는 3년 넘게 지속된 부진한 화물 시장으로 인한 운송업체 감소와 함께 영어능력 요건 강화, 비거주자 상업면허 취소, 운전학교 감독 강화, 멕시코 B-1 비자 소지자의 카보타지 위반 단속 등 규제 강화를 원인으로 지목했다. DAT Freight & Analytics에 따르면 평균 스팟 운임은 2분기 동안 18.9% 상승해 마일당 3.02달러, 계약 운임은 13% 상승해 마일당 3.06달러를 기록했으며 연료비도 전분기 대비 47.1% 오른 마일당 75센트를 기록했다. 지역별로는 남서부에서 물동량과 지출 간 격차가 가장 컸으며(물동량 20.2% 감소, 지출 39.9% 증가), 서부는 수입 활동과 재건 수요에 힘입어 물동량이 5.5% 증가해 가장 강한 성장세를 보였다.

Trucker Path는 100만 명 이상의 트럭 운전자가 트럭 정류장, 주차장, 계근소 검색에 서비스를 이용한다고 밝혔다. 이는 의회가 DOT의 INFRA 보조금 프로그램을 통해 트럭 주차 프로젝트에 배정한 2억 달러 예산에 추가되는 것이며, OOIDA는 트럭 주차 투자가 미국 트럭 운전자의 최우선 안전 과제라고 강조했다.

Werner Enterprises의 Daragh Mahon은 AI가 의사결정 속도와 품질을 높이고 있으며 장기적으로 운영의 자연스러운 일부가 될 것이라고 밝혔고, 실제로 화물 예약 일정을 자동화하는 AI 통신 도구를 도입해 트럭 상차·하차 시간을 최적화하고 가동률을 높였다. Platform Science의 Jack Kennedy는 AI 도입 성공의 기반은 자사 비즈니스의 고유한 강점을 명확히 이해하는 것이라며, 유행을 좇기보다 자사에 맞는 문제 해결에 집중해야 한다고 조언했다. Daimler Truck과 Volvo Group의 합작사 Coretura의 Johan Lundén은 소프트웨어 정의 차량 플랫폼과 커넥티드카 기술이 향후 AI 응용을 위한 데이터 통합과 혁신 가속화에 핵심적인 역할을 할 것이라고 전망했다.

12 북미 Wabash, "2분기 트레일러 수요는 지난 40년과 다르다"
Wabash: Q2 trailer demand unlike any of past 40 years
2026-07-30
Wabash CEO Brent Yeagy는 화물 시장 회복이 40년 만에 유례없는 방식으로 트레일러 수요를 견인하고 있다고 밝혔으나, 회사는 2026년 2분기에도 적자를 기록했다. 2분기 말 수주 잔고는 9억 5,600만 달러로 3개월 전 대비 14% 증가했으며, 회사 역사상 처음으로 2분기에 수주 잔고가 증가한 사례다. ACT Research에 따르면 4월 주문은 전년 대비 126%, 5월은 12%, 6월은 144% 증가했고, 6월 주문은 5월 대비 133% 늘었다. Wabash는 이러한 수요 증가에 힘입어 2026년 하반기부터 단계적으로 가격을 인상하고 2027년에는 인상폭을 더 확대할 계획이며, 통상 가을에 여는 2027년 드라이밴 트레일러 주문을 이례적으로 앞당겨 7월 9일 개시했다. 2분기 트레일러 판매는 8,292대로 전년 동기 대비 3.1%, 전분기 대비 54.2% 증가했지만, 매출은 4억 1,720만 달러로 전년 동기 대비 9.1% 감소했고 순손실은 2,260만 달러로 전년 동기 960만 달러보다 확대됐다(전분기 4,510만 달러보다는 축소). 반면 트럭 바디 판매는 1,380대로 전년 동기 대비 56.7%, 전분기 대비 9.6% 감소했으며, 경영진은 하반기에 완만한 회복을 예상했다.

Blindaje en la México-Orizaba reduce 70.9% el robo a transporte de carga: Gobierno de Puebla
2026-08-19
El Gobierno de Puebla informó queel operativo desplegado en la autopista México-Orizaba 150 D, en el tramo Amozoc-Esperanza, para combatir el robo a transporte de carga, permitió reducir 70.9% la incidencia de este delito entre enero y juliode este año, en comparación con el mismo periodo de 2025.
En conferencia de prensa, el secretario de Seguridad Pública, Francisco Sánchez González, detalló que durante los primeros siete meses de 2026 se reportaron 184 casos al número de emergencias 911, frente a los 632 registrados en el mismo periodo del año pasado.

A estas acciones se sumó la capacitación de 58 operadores del C5i en manejo de crisis y protocolos de atención.
La estrategia de seguridad implementada en Puebla también permitió reforzar el combate al robo de hidrocarburos.
Sánchez González explicó que, tras la explosión registrada el 4 de junio de 2026, autoridades de los tres niveles de gobierno fortalecieron las acciones coordinadas para prevenir y reducir los delitos relacionados con el robo de combustible.
Informó que, del 4 de junio al 16 de agosto, las fuerzas de seguridad recuperaron 178 mil 370 litros de combustible, aseguraron 34 vehículos y 10 contenedores, además de detener a 11 personas presuntamente relacionadas con este delito.
Asimismo, las autoridades inhabilitaron tres tomas clandestinas como parte de los operativos implementados durante ese periodo.

5 LATAM The Battery War Intensifies: BYD and CATL Vie for Solid-State Leadership With Nearly Identical Timelines
The Battery War Intensifies: BYD and CATL Vie for Solid-State Leadership With Nearly Identical Timelines
2026-08-18
CATLandBYD, China’s two largest battery and electric vehicle makers, have escalated their rivalry in recent weeks over who will dominateall-solid-state batteries—a game-changing technology that promiseshigher energy density, lower weight, and improved safetyby swapping liquid electrolytes for solid materials.
Both companies have set2027as the target for starting small-scale pilot production. That virtually identical timeline underscores just how fast this industrial race is accelerating, keeping the entire industry on high alert.
The announcements came just days apart:CATLshared its plans with investors on July 29, whileBYDhad six new patents published by theChina National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA)on July 31, 2026.
Also of interest |General Motors Accelerates Electrification and Hybrid Strategy in South America with Historic Investment
CATL, the world’s largest EV battery manufacturer, officially confirmed its goal of beginning small-scale production of solid-state cells in2027.
The company plans to launch pilot lines at its Yibin facility with roughly2 GWhof capacity, where it will start manufacturing small batches of cells to validate industrial processes, evaluate real-world performance, and analyze production costs.
However,CATLhas been careful to temper expectations about immediate commercialization.Robin Zeng Yuqunstated that solid-state technology is currently atLevel 4on a nine-point Technology Readiness Level (TRL) scale—meaning it is still in lab validation and prototype development.
Wu Kaiset the target of reachingLevels 7 or 8by2027, which would allow for testing much closer to real-world driving conditions and justify launching the first pilot lines. The company also indicated that large-scale production—equivalent to roughlyone million vehicles—won’t happen before2030.
On the technical front,CATLhas begun pilot production of solid-state cells with an energy density of500 Wh/kg—roughly double what today’s best conventional lithium-ion batteries deliver. The company is developing sulfide-based solid electrolyte technology, and its patents reveal advancements in anode materials that include layers with a substrate material, a cobalt-rich material, and a coating containing an electrolyte salt.
Another patent describes a double-layer cathode composite structure that blends monocrystalline and polycrystalline materials to balance structural stability with rate capability (the ability to maintain charge under high demand).
The tight alignment of their timelines makes it clear just how fiercely competition is accelerating inside China to dominate the next generation of batteries. The fact thatCATLandBYDmoved almost simultaneously underscores the competitive pressure in the Chinese market and the urgency not to fall behind in a technology considered strategic for the future of EVs.
One of the biggest hurdles to bringing solid-state batteries to the mass market isprice. BothCATLandBYDbelieve the first solid-state cells will carry significantly higher production costs than conventional lithium-ion cells, so initial commercial applications will be reserved for high-end vehicles.
Robin Zengnoted that early integration will be limited to automotive platforms priced above250,000 yuan(roughly $37,000 USD).BYD, while not offering concrete figures, indicated its first solid-state batteries will also debut in its premium models first.
Both companies agree that mass production—and the cost reductions needed to reach lower-priced vehicles—won’t materialize until after2030. By then, the market should have enough volume to justify the investments required to scale the technology.
The big question on everyone’s mind is who will get there first.CATLstarts with an edge in global scale and R&D firepower, butBYDhas the advantage of being both a vehicle and battery manufacturer, allowing it to integrate advancements into its own models much faster.
What’s clear is that the competition betweenCATLandBYDis accelerating innovation in a sector that, for years, promised breakthroughs without committing to specific dates. Now, with concrete industrial timelines, published patents, and clear readiness targets, the race for thesolid-state batteryhas entered its most decisive phase.

10 LATAM EU pone en la mira a la carga de transbordo, acusa a 40 países de evadir aranceles
EU pone en la mira a la carga de transbordo, acusa a 40 países de evadir aranceles
2026-08-14
Estados Unidos identificó a más de 40 países con un riesgo elevado de transbordo ilegal, entre ellos México, una práctica de enviar mercancías a través de jurisdicciones con aranceles más bajos antes de que ingresen al mercado estadounidense.
En un informe denominado, “La gran estafa del transbordo”, Estados Unidos expone que el transbordo ilegal puede implicar cambiar etiquetas, reempaquetar, volver a facturar, realizar un procesamiento menor, declarar falsamente el país de origen para evadir aranceles.
Te recomendamos leer:Estados Unidos propone aranceles a remolques de México y China
Dicho informe considera en un primer nivel a los países y bloques comerciales que concentran grandes volúmenes absolutos de mercancías vinculadas con China, pero que también cuentan con bases industriales diversificadas y grandes plataformas de exportación hacia Estados Unidos.
En esta lista están Canadá, la Unión Europea, India, Israel, Japón, México, Corea del Sur y Taiwán.
De acuerdo con el informe de la Casa Blanca,este tipo de prácticas pueden suponer recursos entre 40,000 millones y 303,000 millones de dólares anuales, según estimaciones de organismos gubernamentales y del sector privado, que utilizan diferentes bases de datos, metodologías, filtros de productos y definiciones de transbordo ilegal.
Te recomendamos leer:Caen exportaciones de la industria automotriz a Estados Unidos en marzo
No obstante, de acuerdo con el informe de la Casa Blanca, bajo un escenario central de 75,000 millones de dólares anuales de transbordo ilegal, implica aproximadamente 450,000 empleos desplazados.
Así como entre 113,000 y 150,000 millones de dólares de reducción anual del PIB; y entre 19,000 y 26,000 millones de dólares de pérdidas de ingresos federales.
La Casa Blanca destacó la práctica de China  de utilizar estos terceros países para realizar procesamiento menor; cambio de etiquetas; reempaque; refacturación; o cambios de ruta.
Cuando un producto chino sujeto a un arancel estadounidense elevado puede ser enviado a través de un país con una tasa arancelaria menor, la diferencia se convierte en una fuente de ganancias.
Entre la red para la carga de transbordo que considera Estados Unidosse ubican centros de acabado; plataformas logísticas; corredores de procesamiento; operadores de zonas francas; y centros de reexportación.

Kia Méxicohas officiallyunveiledtheKia EV3 2027, marking the South Korean brand’s first 100% electric vehicle to be built on Mexican soil.
This launch represents a major milestone in the company’s global electrification strategy, positioning thePesquería plantin Nuevo León as a production hub for EVs destined for both the domestic and export markets.
TheKia EV3 2027is the first battery electric vehicle (BEV) thatKiahas assembled in Mexico. Production kicked off on August 4 at the Pesquería facility, which underwent a comprehensive modernization and retooling process to accommodate a dedicated line for this electric SUV.
The automaker has earmarked$649 millionfor the project, running through 2028. That investment covers not only plant upgrades but also supply chain enhancements, charging infrastructure, renewable energy, and water recycling initiatives tied to the industrial complex.
During the presentation,Andy Kimhighlighted the significance of the launch for both the company and the country. “Every ‘Hecho en México‘ vehicle that rolls off our plant floor reflects the world-class talent, passion, and dedication of our Mexican workforce, demonstrating to the world what we can achieve together,” the executive stated.

TheKia EV3 2027is a subcompact SUV measuring 4.3 meters in length with a 2.68-meter wheelbase. It is built on the 400-volte-GMPelectric platform—a dedicated EV architecture that optimizes interior space, improves energy efficiency, and integrates advanced safety and connectivity systems.
The EV3’s electric motor delivers201 horsepowerand209 lb-ftof torque. When it comes to range, the model is offered in two configurations:
On charging, the 58.3 kWh version can go from 10% to 80% in approximately29 minutes, while the 81.4 kWh version does the same in roughly31 minutes.
TheKia EV3 2027is the first model in the brand’s Mexican lineup to feature theKia Connectplatform—a connectivity suite that provides access to Over-The-Air (OTA) remote updates,Digital Key 2.0, and the newKia Oneapp.

On the safety front, the EV3 incorporates Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and features aNACS(North American Charging Standard) port, making it compatible withTesla‘s charging network.
The EV3’s design followsKia‘s “Opposites United” philosophy, with geometric lines and clean surfaces that give it a bold, futuristic look. The Star Map daytime running lights and the signature Tiger Face grille reinforce its distinctive visual identity.
The$649 millioninvestment in the Pesquería plant not only modernizes the facility but also delivers a significant boost to employment and the supply chain. The project is expected to generate500 new direct jobsin 2026 and an additional1,500 by 2030.
The Mexico-built EV3 will initially have about27% local content, a figure that is expected to climb as more regional suppliers are brought into the program. High-value components, such as battery packs, will arrive from Asia initially and gradually shift to suppliers located closer to Pesquería.
The investment program also includes funding for public and semi-public charging infrastructure along key corridors in Mexico, tied toKia‘s dealer network, as well as renewable energy and water recycling projects at the plant.
TheKia EV3 2027is now available throughKia México‘s dealer network and viaMercadoLibre—an unprecedented sales strategy for the brand. Launch prices are set at689,700 Mexican pesosfor the EX version and767,700 pesosfor the SXL version.

The company noted that electrified vehicles currently account for25%ofKia‘s global sales, with a target of reaching52%by 2030.

20 Million Electric Vehicles Sold Worldwide and an Underlying Problem: Can Latin America Support Smart Charging?
2026-08-12
During the webinar“Plan México 2030: Nearshoring, Manufacturing and the Smart Charging Ecosystem,”organized byLatam Mobility, three industry leaders agreed on a stark reality:electromobility in the region is advancing at a rapid pace, but charging infrastructure and grid capacity are failing to keep pace.
The event brought togetherMaría Cabeza, Country Manager ofSynergEVin Mexico;Fadwa Kingsbury, Director of Operations atAmpcontrol; andKathy Ardila, Commercial Manager ofInvest in Latamas moderator, to highlight the challenges and opportunities shaping the energy transition across the continent.
You may also be interested |BYD, CATL and FAW will lead the revolution of the ultra-fast charger: the time will pass in seconds
The world closed out 2025 with a historic record in electric vehicle sales. According to the latestGlobal EV Outlookreport from theInternational Energy Agency (IEA), global sales surpassed 20 million units for the first time, representing more than a quarter of the global new car market.
This growth, which has remained steady despite economic uncertainty, positions electric vehicles as a mass phenomenon rather than a passing trend.
Projections for 2026 are equally optimistic. The IEA revised its forecasts upward, estimating that electric vehicles will represent 29% of global car sales—equivalent to approximately 23 million units.
Latin America, with growth exceeding 100% in sales during the first half of 2026, has emerged as a key engine of global growth. Mexico and Brazil, along with Colombia, Uruguay, and Argentina, lead this regional dynamism.
In this context of exponential growth, Mexico positions itself as a strategic player thanks to the nearshoring phenomenon, which has attracted foreign investment for the manufacturing of electric vehicles and auto parts. However, during the webinar it became clear thatvehicle production is not advancing at the same pace as the deployment of smart charging infrastructure.
María Cabezawas emphatic: “Mexico is setting the course in production, but growth in charging infrastructure isn’t keeping pace. For these vehicles to be sold, users need the certainty and peace of mind of being able to charge.” TheSynergEVexecutive highlighted that while Mexico occupies a key place alongside Brazil in regional manufacturing, the central challenge lies in balancing the scales to ensure vehicle supply is met with a reliable charging network.
Fadwa Kingsburyechoed this view, focusing on grid capacity: “Even if there are thousands of vehicles, the problem is going to be grid capacity. The big challenge we are going to face is how to handle all that extra load.”
TheAmpcontroldirector warned that Mexico can learn from Europe’s experiences, where countries like Germany and the Netherlands face similar challenges and have begun integrating batteries, solar panels, and generators to sustain the demand of electric fleets.
Kathy Ardilaemphasized the opportunity that renewable energies represent to overcome the limitations of the current grid. “The main challenge, not only in Mexico but throughout Latin America, is the capacity of the installed grid, which is not technologically advanced enough. That is where the implementation of solar projects and hybrid solutions plays a fundamental role, especially in non-interconnected locations.”
Beyond the physical connection between the vehicle and the charger, the panelists agreed thatthe future of electromobility lies in smart energy management through software, data, and artificial intelligence (AI).
María Cabezaexplained thatSynergEVoffers 360-degree solutions that integrate hardware and software to optimize energy use according to the user type: residential, fleets, or charging hubs. “It’s not just about the charger working; it’s about financial sustainability. Energy must be used based on smart services, considering electricity rates and consumption peaks,” she detailed.
Fadwa Kingsburydelved intoAmpcontrol‘s approach—a platform that centralizes all data in a single software suite: from communication with chargers via the OCPP protocol to vehicle telemetry, battery state of charge, and route planning. “Bringing all the data together allows for efficient planning. It’s not just about knowing that there are peak rates, but that those rates coincide with the times when vehicles are in the depot,” she explained.
The executive added that AI allows predictive identification of failures and resolves 99% of issues before they occur, representing aquantum leapcompared to traditional maintenance models.
Both experts agreed that operational flexibility is just as important as technology.“Depots and fleets are used to operating a certain way with traditional vehicles, but electric vehicles require a new mode of operation. If people don’t adapt, the tools are useless,”Kingsbury warned.
The webinar also served as a platform to make industry announcements.María Cabezarevealed thatSynergEV, a US-based company, will install its first assembly plant in Mexico in early 2027. This decision, she explained, responds to the need to streamline delivery times and offer more efficient after-sales service—two of the main pain points in the Mexican market, especially in a context of tariff and customs challenges. “We are happy because we will be able to respond more quickly to our customers,” she stated.
Fadwa Kingsburyhighlighted thatAmpcontrolis focused on integrating multiple energy sources—solar panels, batteries, and buildings—to coordinate all energy on a single platform. “We want operators to be able to add more vehicles without needing to install more chargers, making the most of existing infrastructure,” she explained. The executive emphasized the importance of long-term planning, considering not only current demand but also the projected growth of electric fleets.

15 LATAM Isuzu lleva la movilidad más allá del transporte con «Rodar por Ayudar» 2026
Isuzu lleva la movilidad más allá del transporte con «Rodar por Ayudar» 2026
2026-08-12
Como parte de su responsabilidad social y con el objetivo de seguir contribuyendo al bienestar de las comunidades mexicanas y devolver parte de lo que el país le ha brindado a la compañía durante más de dos décadas de presencia,Isuzu Motors de México anunció la edición 2026 de «Rodar por Ayudar».
El programa, que se llevará a cabo de agosto a noviembre de este año,contempla la entregas de sillas de ruedas en distintas entidades del país en coordinación con la Red Nacional de Concesionarios Isuzu,lo que permitirá llevar el programa a distintas regiones del país y generar un impacto directo en las comunidades donde la marca tiene presencia.
Te recomendamos leer:Utilidades de Isuzu crecen a doble dígito en su primer trimestre fiscal
Isuzu explicó que este año cuentan con el apoyo de la Fundación Bertha O. de Osete, I.A.P.,institución con más de tres décadas de experiencia y más de 100,000 personas beneficiadas en México a través de programas que promueven la movilidad, la autonomía y la inclusión.
Uno de los aspectos que distingue el trabajo de la fundación es que las sillas de ruedas y otros dispositivos de movilidad son fabricados en México,utilizando componentes de fácil acceso para su mantenimiento y reparación, incluyendo piezas compatibles con bicicletas convencionales. Esto facilita que los usuarios puedan mantener sus dispositivos en condiciones adecuadas de funcionamiento y prolongar su vida útil.
Asimismo, la labor de la fundación tiene un impacto que va más allá de la entrega de los dispositivos, ya que brinda oportunidades laborales a personas con discapacidad que participan en la fabricación de estos productos, generando un modelo que vincula movilidad, inclusión laboral y desarrollo social.
Te recomendamos leer:Isuzu fortalece su portafolio en México con el lanzamiento de la pick up D-MAX
«El año pasado iniciamos Rodar por Ayudar con la convicción de agradecer a México la confianza que ha depositado en nuestra marca durante dos décadas», comentóHiroshi Ikewaga, presidente y director general de Isuzu Motors de México.
«Este año queremos dar continuidad a ese compromiso a través de una acción que tiene un significado muy especial para nosotros:contribuir a que más personas puedan contar con las herramientas necesarias para desplazarse con mayor independencia. Para Isuzu, la movilidad no solo significa transportar personas o mercancías; también representa una oportunidad para transformar vidas y generar un impacto positivo en la sociedad», añadió Ikewaga.
El programa «Rodar por Ayudar» nació en 2025 como una iniciativa conmemorativa por el 20 aniversario de Isuzu Motors de México, con el propósito de apoyar a diversas instituciones de asistencia social en distintas regiones del país y devolver, a través de este esfuerzo, parte de lo que México le ha brindado a la compañía durante más de dos décadas de presencia.
A partir de la experiencia obtenida durante la primera edición y de las necesidades identificadas,este año Isuzu decidió enfocar sus acciones en el acceso a dispositivos que favorezcan la movilidad de las personas.
Con las acciones de «Rodar por Ayudar» 2026,Isuzu Motors de Méxicoreafirma su compromiso de contribuir al desarrollo de las comunidades mexicanasmediante proyectos que promueven la inclusión y generan un impacto positivo.
